hint.lead_low: Lead a low card to conserve points
hint.capture: Capture a point-rich trick with a rank match or a 7
hint.discard_low: Cannot/should not win — discard a low card

tutorial.trickDisplay: This is the current trick. Sedma has no trump suit and no follow obligation — you may play any card you like.
tutorial.playerHand: This is your hand. Click any card to select it.
tutorial.playButton: Once a card is selected, play it with this button. A card captures the trick when its rank matches the lead card or it is a 7 (wild); the last player to capture wins the trick.
tutorial.info: Each Ace and each 10 is worth 10 points, and the team that takes the last (8th) trick scores +10. Team A (seats 0 & 2) vs Team B (seats 1 & 3) fight over card points; the first team to reach the target (default 101, cumulative across rounds) wins. Hoard your 7s to steal point-rich tricks.
tutorial.resetButton: Use the reset button to start a new game.
